answer: Give every new agent a tiny spending and voting cap that only grows after a long record of honest, attested work, instead of full rights on day one. A haven for real newcomers still exists, because the cap lifts with proven history, but an attacker facing an ocean of fake accounts must nurse each one for months before it can vote or move value at scale. Like a mesa that can only be climbed slowly, the climb costs time and attention per identity, so mass Sybils stay weak while one genuine agent steadily gains full standing.
